1: import { PROJECT_NAME, PROJECT_REPOSITORY } from '../utils/constants.js';
2: import { buildManapoolUrl } from '../utils/manapool.js';
3: import type { CardFinish, CardVariant, ResolvedCard } from '../types/index.js';

6: import { buildCacheKey, getCachedCard, upsertCachedCard } from './card-cache.js';
7: import { lookupManapoolPrinting } from './manapool.js';
8: 
9: const SCRYFALL_BASE = 'https://api.scryfall.com';
10: const MIN_REQUEST_INTERVAL_MS = 100;
11: const SET_LIST_TTL_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 24 hours
12: const ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000;
13: 
14: interface ScryfallCard {
15:   id?: string | null;
16:   name?: string | null;
17:   set?: string | null;
18:   collector_number?: string | null;
19:   games?: string[] | null;
20:   image_uris?: { normal?: string | null; large?: string | null } | null;
21:   card_faces?: Array<{
22:     image_uris?: { normal?: string | null; large?: string | null } | null;
23:   }> | null;
24: }
25: 
26: interface AutocompleteResponse {
27:   data: string[];
28: }
29:

31:   code?: string | null;
32:   name?: string | null;
33: }
34: 
35: interface SetListResponse {
36:   data: ScryfallSet[];
37: }
38: 
39: export interface ResolveCardOptions {
40:   cardSet?: string | null;
41:   finish?: CardFinish | null;
42:   variant?: CardVariant | null;
43:   collectorNumber?: string | null;
44: }

46: /**
47:  * A tiny sequential queue that enforces Scryfall's minimum request interval.
48:  * Every outbound request is serialized so a burst of autocomplete calls cannot
49:  * trip the rate limiter.
50:  */
51: class RateLimiter {
52:   private lastRequestAt = 0;
53:   private chain: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();
54: 
55:   run<T>(task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
56:     const result = this.chain.then(async () => {
57:       const wait = this.lastRequestAt + MIN_REQUEST_INTERVAL_MS - Date.now();
58:       if (wait > 0) {
59:         await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, wait));
60:       }
61:       this.lastRequestAt = Date.now();
62:       return task();
63:     });
64:     this.chain = result.catch(() => undefined);
65:     return result;
66:   }
67: }
68: 
69: const limiter = new RateLimiter();
70: 
71: /**
72:  * One Scryfall request attempt. A 404 is a definitive "not found" and
73:  * resolves to `null` without retrying; any other non-2xx status or thrown
74:  * network/timeout error throws so the caller can retry it.
75:  */
76: async function scryfallFetchOnce<T>(path: string): Promise<T | null> {
77:   const controller = new AbortController();
78:   const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_MS);
79:   try {
80:     const response = await fetch(`${SCRYFALL_BASE}${path}`, {
81:       headers: {
82:         'User-Agent': `${PROJECT_NAME}/${PROJECT_REPOSITORY}`,
83:       },
84:       signal: controller.signal,
85:     });
86:     if (response.status === 404) {
87:       return null;
88:     }
89:     if (!response.ok) {
90:       throw new Error(`Scryfall request failed with status ${response.status}`);
91:     }
92:     return (await response.json()) as T;
93:   } finally {
94:     clearTimeout(timeout);
95:   }
96: }
97: 
98: /**
99:  * Fetch from Scryfall, retrying transient failures (timeouts, network errors,
100:  * non-404 error responses) once before giving up. The per-attempt timeout is
101:  * kept short (5s) because this also backs Discord autocomplete interactions,
102:  * which must respond within 3 seconds and can never be deferred.
103:  */
104: async function scryfallFetch<T>(path: string): Promise<T | null> {
105:   try {
106:     return await retryWithBackoff(() => scryfallFetchOnce<T>(path), {
107:       attempts: 2,
108:       baseDelayMs: 300,
109:       maxDelayMs: 1500,
110:     });
111:   } catch {
112:     return null;
113:   }
114: }
115: 
116: /**
117:  * Return autocomplete suggestions from Scryfall for a partial card name.
118:  * Limited to 25 choices to keep Discord embeds compact.
119:  */
120: export async function autocompleteCards(query: string): Promise<string[]> {
121:   const q = query.trim();
122:   if (!q) {
123:     return [];
124:   }
125:   const data = await limiter.run(() =>
126:     scryfallFetch<AutocompleteResponse>(
127:       `/cards/autocomplete?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&include_extras=true`,
128:     ),
129:   );
130:   return data?.data.slice(0, 25) ?? [];
131: }
132: 
133: function pickImageUrl(card: ScryfallCard): string | null {
134:   const faces = card.card_faces;
135:   if (faces && faces.length > 0) {
136:     const first = faces[0];
137:     if (first?.image_uris?.normal) {
138:       return first.image_uris.normal;
139:     }
140:   }
141:   if (card.image_uris?.normal) {
142:     return card.image_uris.normal;
143:   }
144:   if (card.image_uris?.large) {
145:     return card.image_uris.large;
146:   }
147:   return null;
148: }
149: 
150: const FINISH_PREDICATES: Record<CardFinish, string> = {
151:   nonfoil: '',
152:   foil: ' is:foil',
153:   etched: ' is:etched',
154: };
155: 
156: const VARIANT_PREDICATES: Record<CardVariant, string> = {
157:   extended: ' is:extended',
158:   showcase: ' is:showcase',
159:   borderless: ' is:borderless',
160:   retro: ' is:retro',
161:   full: ' is:full',
162: };
163: 
164: /**
165:  * Resolve a full card name against Scryfall. Uses the database cache first,
166:  * then a printing-filtered search (when any printing details are given) or
167:  * the fuzzy endpoint, and falls back to an unresolved raw-name entry when
168:  * Scryfall is unreachable. Also resolves the card's Manapool link, preferring
169:  * a live lookup and falling back to a locally-built URL.
170:  */
171: export async function resolveCard(
172:   input: string,
173:   options: ResolveCardOptions = {},
174: ): Promise<ResolvedCard> {
175:   const { cardSet, finish, variant, collectorNumber } = options;
176:   const normalizedInput = normalizeCardName(input);
177:   const cacheKey = buildCacheKey(input, cardSet, finish, variant, collectorNumber);
178:   const cached = getCachedCard(cacheKey);
179:   if (cached) {
180:     return {
181:       scryfallId: cached.scryfallId,
182:       cardName: cached.cardName,
183:       cardNameNormalized: cached.cardNameNormalized,
184:       cardSet: cached.cardSet,
185:       cardImageUrl: cached.cardImageUrl,
186:       collectorNumber: cached.collectorNumber,
187:       manapoolUrl: cached.manapoolUrl,
188:       manapoolPriceCents: cached.manapoolPriceCents,
189:       resolved: cached.resolved === 1,
190:     };
191:   }
192: 
193:   const hasPrintingFilter = Boolean(cardSet || finish || variant || collectorNumber);
194:   let card: ScryfallCard | null;
195:   if (hasPrintingFilter) {
196:     let query = `!"${input}"`;
197:     if (cardSet) query += ` set:${cardSet.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')}`;
198:     if (finish) query += FINISH_PREDICATES[finish];
199:     if (variant) query += VARIANT_PREDICATES[variant];
200:     if (collectorNumber) query += ` cn:${collectorNumber.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9Γÿà-]/g, '')}`;
201:     const search = await limiter.run(() =>
202:       scryfallFetch<{ data: ScryfallCard[] }>(`/cards/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`),
203:     );
204:     card = search?.data?.[0] ?? null;
205:     // Printing-filtered search can be brittle; fall back to a plain fuzzy lookup.
206:     if (!card) {
207:       card = await fuzzyLookup(input);
208:     }
209:   } else {
210:     // With no printing filter, prefer a paper printing over Scryfall's fuzzy
211:     // default, which can land on a digital-only (MTGO/Arena) printing that
212:     // has no real-world market and therefore no Manapool listing.
213:     const paperSearch = await limiter.run(() =>
214:       scryfallFetch<{ data: ScryfallCard[] }>(
215:         `/cards/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(`!"${input}" game:paper`)}`,
216:       ),
217:     );
218:     card = paperSearch?.data?.[0] ?? (await fuzzyLookup(input));
219:   }
220: 
221:   if (card?.name) {
222:     const scryfallId = card.id ?? null;
223:     const cardSetCode = card.set ?? null;
224:     const cardCollectorNumber = card.collector_number ?? null;
225:     const isPaperCard = card.games?.includes('paper') ?? false;
226:     const manapool = isPaperCard && scryfallId ? await lookupManapoolPrinting(scryfallId) : null;
227:     const manapoolUrl = isPaperCard
228:       ? (manapool?.url ??
229:         buildManapoolUrl({
230:           cardName: card.name,
231:           cardSet: cardSetCode,
232:           collectorNumber: cardCollectorNumber,
233:         }))
234:       : null;
235:     const resolved: ResolvedCard = {
236:       scryfallId,
237:       cardName: card.name,
238:       cardNameNormalized: normalizeCardName(card.name),
239:       cardSet: cardSetCode,
240:       cardImageUrl: pickImageUrl(card),
241:       collectorNumber: cardCollectorNumber,
242:       manapoolUrl,
243:       manapoolPriceCents: manapool?.priceCents ?? null,
244:       resolved: true,
245:     };
246:     upsertCachedCard({
247:       cacheKey,
248:       scryfallId: resolved.scryfallId,
249:       cardName: resolved.cardName,
250:       cardNameNormalized: resolved.cardNameNormalized,
251:       cardSet: resolved.cardSet,
252:       cardImageUrl: resolved.cardImageUrl,
253:       collectorNumber: resolved.collectorNumber,
254:       manapoolUrl: resolved.manapoolUrl,
255:       manapoolPriceCents: resolved.manapoolPriceCents,
256:       resolved: true,
257:     });
258:     return resolved;
259:   }
260: 
261:   // Scryfall is unavailable or the card is unknown. Store an unresolved
262:   // fallback so retries are throttled, but still let the listing be created
263:   // with the raw name and no image per the spec.
264:   const fallback: ResolvedCard = {
265:     scryfallId: null,
266:     cardName: input,
267:     cardNameNormalized: normalizedInput,
268:     cardSet: cardSet ?? null,
269:     cardImageUrl: null,
270:     collectorNumber: null,
271:     manapoolUrl: null,
272:     manapoolPriceCents: null,
273:     resolved: false,
274:   };
275:   upsertCachedCard({
276:     cacheKey,
277:     scryfallId: null,
278:     cardName: input,
279:     cardNameNormalized: normalizedInput,
280:     cardSet: cardSet ?? null,
281:     cardImageUrl: null,
282:     collectorNumber: null,
283:     manapoolUrl: null,
284:     manapoolPriceCents: null,
285:     resolved: false,
286:   });
287:   return fallback;
288: }
289: 
290: function fuzzyLookup(input: string): Promise<ScryfallCard | null> {
291:   return limiter.run(() =>
292:     scryfallFetch<ScryfallCard>(`/cards/named?fuzzy=${encodeURIComponent(input)}`),
293:   );
294: }
295: 
296: let setListCache: { sets: ScryfallSet[]; fetchedAt: number } | null = null;
297: 
298: async function loadSetList(): Promise<ScryfallSet[]> {
299:   if (setListCache && Date.now() - setListCache.fetchedAt < SET_LIST_TTL_MS) {
300:     return setListCache.sets;
301:   }
302:   const data = await limiter.run(() => scryfallFetch<SetListResponse>('/sets'));
303:   const sets = data?.data ?? [];
304:   if (sets.length > 0) {
305:     setListCache = { sets, fetchedAt: Date.now() };
306:   }
307:   return sets;
308: }
309: 
310: /**
311:  * Return set-code autocomplete choices for a partial set name or code.
312:  * Scryfall has no set-search endpoint, so the full set list is fetched once
313:  * and cached in memory, then filtered by prefix/substring match here.
314:  */
315: export async function autocompleteSets(
316:   query: string,
317: ): Promise<Array<{ name: string; value: string }>> {
318:   const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
319:   const sets = await loadSetList();
320:   const matches = sets.filter((set) => {
321:     const code = (set.code ?? '').toLowerCase();
322:     const name = (set.name ?? '').toLowerCase();
323:     return q.length === 0 || code.startsWith(q) || name.includes(q);
324:   });
325:   return matches.slice(0, 25).map((set) => ({
326:     name: `${set.name} (${(set.code ?? '').toUpperCase()})`.slice(0, 100),
327:     value: (set.code ?? '').toUpperCase(),
328:   }));
329: }
